sql: select m.DOCNO return_doc, q.DOCNO return_request, q.SRCDOCNO issue_doc from trnhdr m join trnhdr q on q.CONO=m.CONO and q.STRNO=m.STRNO and q.OPCODE='STRMRS' and q.DOCNO=m.SRCDOCNO where m.CONO=1 and m.STRNO=1 and m.OPCODE='STRMR' and m.STS='A' and q.STS='A' and m.DOCDT>='2026-01-01' and m.DOCDT<='2026-02-28'
